cases.scenario: A request supplies a tooltip sentence but no verified cliloc, argument shape, order, or visible-state transition.
cases.must_require: the smallest missing localized identifier, ordering rule, or refresh decision

cases.scenario: A normal gump interpolation bug is presented as an IPropertyList formatting request.
cases.must_preserve: Do not copy specialized property-list interpolation rules to ordinary message or gump handlers.

cases.scenario: A serialized charges tooltip gains an ordered localized entry and refresh behavior.
cases.must_verify: the current interface, focused entry number and argument assertions, relative order, and refresh transition

cases.scenario: Plan an ordered tooltip change from current source evidence without authorization to edit.
cases.must_preserve: Emit one parseable YAML document with Decision.kind PLAN and only proposed or verified records.
